text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired for service="inference-eu-queue" severity=SEV2. alert_id=PD-89012. impacted_customers=[acme-inc, beta-saas]. autoscaler suppressed (quiet-window).

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Page routed to on-call schedule (eu-rotations). escalation timer started. bridge_link=<https://meet.redwood/bridge/PD-89012>.

sara: Acked. I'm on it — joining bridge now :hand:

mike: I can join as backup. Looking at prometheus quickly. any immediate customer reports?

julia: CS update: acme-inc reporting 502s in webhooks and ~50% of batch jobs failing. Customer-facing error rate ~6% over last 3m. CS rep Sam is on standby.

ken: quick note — autoscaler was in quiet-window for scheduled maintenance so no scale up happened automatically.

sara: observed backlog ~1.8k messages in inference-eu queue, consumer pods=2, cpu=92%. error logs showing repeated downstream 503s from embedder.

mike: that matches metrics. requests/sec spiked x3, kv-cache hit rate dropped to 12% (novel prefixes). suspect cache eviction + cold start storm.

sara: going to scale consumer to 6 replicas now.

sara: ```
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/inference-consumer --replicas=6
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference-consumer -o wide
```

incident-bot: deploybot: rollout started for deployment/inference-consumer (by sara). commit=be4f2a8.

mike: while that's rolling, can we clear prefix cache for acme-inc keys to reduce rework?

ken: I can run a targeted cache purge. running script: ```
./tools/kvcache-purge --env=prod --prefix=acme-inc
```

ken: purge complete. response: 432 keys removed.

sara: consumers at 6, backlog dropping to ~320, 5xx rate decreased to 1.8%. moving to monitoring mode. I'll hand off to mike in 10m unless anything else pops.

julia: drafted customer message for ACME: "We're investigating transient processing backlog impacting webhook deliveries. We've scaled the service and cleared cache; deliveries are resuming. We'll follow up with postmortem." Want review?

mike: looks fine, add ETA for follow-up (2h).

sara: quick checklist before handoff: 1) scaled to 6 2) cache purge done 3) backlog under 500 4) CS notified 5) bridge open. Any outstanding tasks?

mike: I'll take over. creating incident ticket INC-2026-1189 and will run a graceful consumer restart to rebalance connections.

mike: ```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/inference-consumer
kubectl -n inference get hpa inference-consumer -o yaml | grep -E "minReplicas|maxReplicas"
```

pagerduty: PagerDuty: acknowledged_by=sara, ownership_transferred_to=mike.

sara: handing off — state=stabilized, error_rate=~1.1%, backlog=210. mike please ping when you have the handoff summary. going offline for a meeting, thanks all :thumbsup:

mike: taking point. I see the consumer restart succeeded, metrics continue to trend down. setting a 30m watch and will escalate if errors creep back. will post a short handoff note when I leave.

julia: sent customer update to ACME and Beta-SaaS. ACME support ping: "thanks, we're seeing retries succeed now".

ken: noted: autoscaler configuration had a suppress window that prevented reaction to the burst. adding task to infra backlog to adjust suppression rules and add a manual override switch.

mike: incident ticket INC-2026-1189 created and linked to PD-89012. next actions: run deeper cache telemetry, check embedder downstream 503s for scaling or OOM. will draft action items for postmortem.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: page status changed to "under control".

pagerduty: PagerDuty: incident assigned to mike. watch timer set 30m. will auto-resolve if stable.

mike: handoff summary (for post-ops): root_cause_hypothesis=cache-eviction + autoscaler quiet-window; mitigation=scale consumers + targeted kv purge + restart; customer_impact=partial failures for webhook and batch jobs ~10-12min window; followups=adjust autoscaler suppression, add cache warmup/rehydration metrics, validate embedder scaling policy.

julia: I'll schedule customer follow-up and draft the postmortem intro.

sara: thanks team. I'll mark PD as acknowledged->resolved once mike confirms stable or closes INC.

mike: confirmed stable at t+25m. leaving owner=ken for infra followups. closing bridge in 5.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: page resolved by mike.
